subject: Operationalizing Kestrel Systems SI Onboarding: Technical workshop and open questions
messages:
From: Elaine Carter <elaine.carter@kestreltech.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel / Redwood onboarding workshop: May 11-12 proposal
Attachments: kestrel-onboard-deck.pdf, network-diagram.png

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Kestrel engineering and solutions teams are excited to get hands-on with Redwood for our pilot engagements. We want to run a two-day technical workshop for our SI delivery leads + two platform engineers to cover:

- Quick environment walkthrough and SSO/KMS prerequisites
- Model selection and quantization guidance for memory-constrained nodes
- Integration patterns (prefix cache, batching, routing policies)
- Runbook: failover + escalation for production inference

Proposed dates: May 11–12 (PST). Attached is a short deck and our infra diagram. Can you confirm:

1) Redwood facilitator(s) availability those dates?
2) Recommended pre-work for our engineers (accounts, sample prompts, test data)?
3) Any hosting/network constraints we should prep for (ports, certs, IP allowlists)?

We can share a calendar invite and a short list of attendees when you confirm.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Carter
Director, Ecosystem & Integrations | Kestrel Systems
elaine.carter@kestreltech.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

---

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Carter <elaine.carter@kestreltech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kestrel / Redwood onboarding workshop: May 11-12 proposal
Attachments: proposed-agenda-v2.docx

Thanks Elaine — this looks great and the dates work on our end. I attached an updated agenda with session owners and a short pre-work checklist. Quick answers inline and a few open asks: 

1) Facilitators: Marissa will lead the integration/ops sessions; Jonas will cover model & quantization; I will run the runbook + SLA/fallback tabletop.
2) Pre-work: please provision two service accounts (one for sandbox + one for staging), add our service IP block to your allowlist, and share a small set of sample inputs (10–20 prompts) so Jonas can prepare model calibration notes.
3) Hosting constraints: we recommend exposing a dedicated jumpbox for the workshop to avoid exposing internal control plane ports; if you prefer VPC peering instead, we can discuss network egress during the call.

Open questions:
- Do you have an internal KMS you want integrated during the lab? If so, Naomi, can you confirm Redwood's supported KMS connectors we should map to Kestrel's provider?
- Elaine, any regulatory notes we should be aware of for demo data (PII masking requirements)?

Once you confirm the pre-work items I'll send invites and a short Ops checklist for the participants.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

---

From: Elaine Carter <elaine.carter@kestreltech.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Apr 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kestrel / Redwood onboarding workshop: May 11-12 proposal
Attachments: kestrel-kms-spec.pdf

Thanks — all good. Quick answers:

- We'll provision the two service accounts by EOD Monday and share credentials over your secure share.
- Kestrel uses Vault-backed KMS (HashiCorp Vault); I've attached our KMS spec — Naomi, happy to do a 30-min pre-call with your team if that helps.
- Demo data: we will provide synthetic datasets with PII masked for the workshop; production data cannot be used in the sandbox.

We prefer the jumpbox approach for the two-day lab; I'll include the requester for firewall rules in the calendar invite.

Elaine

---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: workshop risk & session ownership (Kestrel)

Internal note — do not forward to partner.

Team, quick consolidation of technical risks I spotted in their diagram:
- Vault integration: need runbook for rotating secrets during the lab and explicit guidance if we will mock KMS or attempt a real connector. Jonas, please confirm whether we want to demo real Vault integration or a simulated flow.
- Network: partner mentions jumpbox; confirm we have deterministic IPs for our facilitator machines and document fallback if NAT issues occur. Naomi, can you own firewall rule checklist and provide the ops checklist by May 6?
- Licensing: ensure the model variants we plan to demo are covered under their pilot license (we have temporary sandbox license for Llama-like weights). Marissa will confirm with licensing ops.

Action items:
- Jonas: confirm real vs simulated Vault demo (by May 4)
- Naomi: firewall checklist + secure share link (by May 6)
- Marissa: licensing confirmation (by May 5)

Marissa
VP, Solutions Delivery

---

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Carter <elaine.carter@kestreltech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 4 May 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kestrel / Redwood onboarding workshop: May 11-12 proposal
Attachments: final-invite.ics

Hi Elaine — confirming Redwood team will run the workshop May 11–12. Calendar invite and final agenda are attached (final-invite.ics + proposed-agenda-v2.docx). Quick status:

- Jonas confirmed we will run a simulated Vault integration for the lab and provide a separate short tech note for customers who want to do a live KMS hookup in production.
- Naomi will share the firewall checklist and secure share link by EOD Monday.
- Marissa confirmed licensing for the demo model variants.

Next steps for Kestrel:
1) Provision two service accounts and share credentials via the secure share link Naomi will send.
2) Add Redwood facilitator IP block to allowlist (we will provide IPs in the ops checklist).
3) Upload the 10 sample prompts to the shared folder; Jonas will use them for calibration notes.

Thank you — looking forward to the workshop. If anything changes on your side, flag it ASAP and we'll adjust.

Best,
Stephanie
